invented.quote: Last year I missed that date 3 times out of 12.
invented.why: The brief says she has 31 clients and missed the 10th three times last year, not that she missed it in 3 out of 12 months (with 31 clients, there are hundreds of monthly closes per year, not 12).

invented.quote: That also means I keep set hours.
invented.why: The brief only states that she does not answer the phone on Sundays or Mondays, not that she keeps set hours.
